headline: Bob Mackie's Legacy: 87 Years of Sequins and Dreams Fulfilled
meta_description: Fashion legend Bob Mackie, the 'Sultan of Sequins' who dressed Cher, Elton John, and generations of stars, has died at 87, leaving behind a lifetime of iconic…
summary_short: Legendary costume designer Bob Mackie, known for dressing Cher and Elton John, has passed away at 87, having fulfilled his lifelong dream of creating extraordinary stage…
body:
Bob Mackie lived exactly as he wanted—designing costumes. The legendary fashion designer, who dressed superstars from Cher to Tina Turner to Elton John, died on Monday at age 87, having spent nearly seven decades doing the only thing he ever dreamed of doing. Known as the "Sultan of Sequins" for his signature sparkling creations, Mackie won a Tony Award, nine Emmys, and received three Oscar nominations, but his true legacy lies in the unforgettable moments he created on stage and screen—from Cher's bare-midriff Mohawk outfit at the 1986 Oscars to Sir Elton John's bedazzled Dodgers baseball uniform worn during his 1975 performances at Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles.

Mackie's influence extended across generations. Cher, who became his muse and collaborator, wore his creations to define an era, becoming widely reported as the first woman to show her belly button on US television—thanks partly to Mackie's boldness. More recently, he designed the dress Miley Cyrus wore at the 2024 Grammy Awards, proving his artistry remained relevant and sought-after right up until his death. Pink, who wore his designs for years during her Funhouse tour in 2009, remembered him as "loving, wickedly funny and an absolute genius."

What makes Mackie's story remarkable isn't just the famous names or the accolades—it's that he never wavered from his childhood dream. Born in Monterey Park, California, in 1939, he started as a sketch artist and never stopped creating. When asked by The Guardian in 2018 if he'd ever retire, his answer was simply: "I hope not." He didn't. His genius lives on in the costumes that continue to sparkle across stages worldwide.
quick_facts: Bob Mackie won 1 Tony Award and 9 Emmy Awards during his career
Designed Cher's iconic bare-midriff Mohawk outfit for the 1986 Oscars
Created Elton John's bedazzled Dodgers uniform for 1975 Los Angeles performances
Worked until recently, designing for Miley Cyrus at 2024 Grammy Awards
Born in Monterey Park, California, in 1939; died at age 87
